title: Algorithm Acceptance Audit — freeze and connectivity are not acceptance
issue_presented: Whether existing Governance established a sufficiently explicit acceptance state between algorithm selection/freeze and representation of an algorithm as operative or proven, and what Algorithm Acceptance Audit is required before ACCEPTED, OPERATIVE, PAPER_READY, PRODUCTION_READY, PROVEN_WORKING, or equivalent.

known_facts.fact: G-20 through G-25 briefed the issue. Argument sought a mandatory pre-acceptance audit. Counterargument sought enforcement under J-0017 and standing gates without new law. Meet and Confer left MANDATORY_AUDIT_GATE_REQUIRED unresolved for Human Judgment.

Project 1-3 selected and froze P13-ALG-V1-CAND-TSMOM-60-MONTHLY, built a paper runner, connected Alpaca paper, and represented CREATED→CONNECTED→CALLED→PROVEN WORKING. Subsequent audit established decide() did not compute or execute the frozen algorithm.
known_facts.evidence: algorithm/FROZEN_P13_ALG_V1.json; ADEQ-1-3-PAPER-003; atlas_p13/paper.py decide(); Human-accepted 1-3 frozen-algorithm audit

known_facts.fact: Human entered this Judgment 2026-08-25. IT IS SO ORDERED. No Reply. P13-ALG-V1 remains preserved and is not accepted as a proven forward-operating algorithm. Project 1-3 is remanded for correction under existing project authority.

unknown_or_disputed_facts.fact: Whether any corrected 1-3 candidate will establish a defensible edge under corrected methodology.
unknown_or_disputed_facts.effect: Reserved to Project 1-3 evidence. This Judgment does not pick a winner.

analysis: Existing law already forbade false completion and required substantive adequacy (J-0017; gates 4 and 7). It did not name an acceptance state between freeze and operative/proven labels. 1-3 showed freeze + connect + HOLD + WORKING without executing the freeze. The Court adopts an explicit Algorithm Acceptance Audit for new algorithms and material versions, not for every experiment. Atlas may satisfy the audit autonomously when no Human-reserved issue remains.
judgment_rule: CANDIDATE SELECTION IS NOT ALGORITHM ACCEPTANCE.
BROKER CONNECTIVITY IS NOT ALGORITHM ACCEPTANCE.
A HOLD OBJECT OR SUCCESSFUL INVOCATION IS NOT PROOF THAT THE FROZEN ALGORITHM WAS EXECUTED.

Existing Governance prohibited false claims of completion and required substantive adequacy, but did not establish a sufficiently explicit acceptance state between algorithm selection/freeze and representation of the algorithm as operative or proven. This Judgment supplies that state. It does not repeal J-0017, J-0018, J-0006, or standing gates.

Before an Atlas algorithm may be represented as ACCEPTED, OPERATIVE, PAPER_READY, PRODUCTION_READY, PROVEN_WORKING, or equivalent, Atlas shall perform an Algorithm Acceptance Audit sufficient to establish: (i) the written specification and executable research implementation correspond; (ii) the material historical methodology is reproducible and does not contain undisclosed defects material to the result; (iii) the frozen rules include the material entry, exit, sizing, cash, timing, missing-data, and rebalance behavior actually implemented; (iv) the executable forward implementation computes the frozen algorithm rather than merely connecting to infrastructure; (v) the implementation produces the expected signal and target state from known inputs; (vi) any claimed execution capability is separately proven at the appropriate execution stage.

Audit conclusions shall distinguish, each PROVEN or UNKNOWN (unproven remains UNKNOWN): RESEARCH_REPRODUCED; SPEC_CODE_MATCHED; BROKER_CONNECTED; SIGNAL_COMPUTED; TARGETS_GENERATED; ORDER_PATH_PROVEN; FILL_PATH_PROVEN; SCHEDULER_PROVEN; FORWARD_OPERATION_PROVEN.
The Acceptance Audit is required for a new algorithm or material algorithm version before acceptance, not for every experimental candidate, ordinary run, non-material patch, or routine forward cycle.

A material defect discovered by audit shall preserve the audited version and its result. A materially corrected algorithm receives a new version identity and must satisfy the Acceptance Audit before acceptance.

The audit does not require Human intervention where the record is sufficient and no Human-reserved Judgment or unresolved Governance issue exists. Atlas may conduct and satisfy the audit autonomously.

Project 1-3 existing P13-ALG-V1 record remains preserved. It is not presently accepted as a proven forward-operating algorithm. Project 1-3 is remanded under existing project authority for correction, retesting, versioning as necessary, implementation, and subsequent Acceptance Audit.
Does not authorize live trading. Does not disturb J-0016. Does not designate a Magistrate. Does not require Human sign-off of every experimental freeze.
